EntitlementFeatures.description: Nested, extensible object, one key per feature. An absent key is false, an unknown key is kept and ignored. `{}` takes every right away. An API key standing for an external identity is checked against these features on every call of a route that needs an organization permission, whatever the method: UPLOAD needs `transcription.async`, SUMMARY needs `summary`, MICROPHONE, BOT and SESSION need `transcription.live`, SPEAKER_IDENTIFICATION needs nothing; otherwise 403 `no_entitlement` with the missing feature in `capability`. Ending or deleting is never refused for a missing feature: DELETE of a template, a quick meeting, a bot or a session, and PUT stop, pause and clear of a session. Humans and keys without an external identity are not concerned.

live.description: live transcription during a visio: quick meetings, bots, sessions and session templates (permissions MICROPHONE, BOT, SESSION)

async.description: deferred transcription of a recording: upload, import and regeneration of a conversation (permission UPLOAD)

summary.description: export of a conversation as a document (permission SUMMARY); the json, text and verbatim exports stay open

recording.description: video recording of a visio. Not an AI feature, LinTO is not called for it. Alone, it opens no LinTO right: no key is born, no token is minted for it.
